in_hebrew.name: תומכין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A derivative of the Hebrew word 'tom' which means right hand, and 'kin' meaning strong. This name signifies one who is strong in his right hand or capable of leading and defending.

in_greek.name: Θομκινός
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek derivation of the Hebrew name 'Tomkin'. The name means 'strong in the right hand' and signifies strength and power.

in_latin.name: Tomkinus
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin derivation of the Greek name 'Tomkinos'. This name also signifies strength and power.
